Content:
Namespace ProceduralCreature.Skeleton and ProceduralCreature.Animation(.Ik/.Binding). Skeleton is entirely derived state (never written back to DNA), derived from CreaturePart semantic metadata/hierarchy, NOT from generated mesh topology.

DATA MODEL: Bone (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Skeleton/Bone.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Skeleton, mutable): Id, ParentBoneId (null=root), SourcePartId, PartType, IsMirrored, Position (creature-space REST pose), HasSegment, EndPosition, HasChildAttachmentPosition, ChildAttachmentPosition, Rotation (rest). Skeleton (same file): List<Bone> Bones, FindBone, GetChildren, GetRootBones. Stores ABSOLUTE creature-space rest transforms (not parent-relative), no ordering imposed. SkeletonSnapshot (SkeletonSnapshot.cs): immutable flattened capture imposing deterministic PARENT-BEFORE-CHILD ordering. Capture validates duplicate ids/missing parents/cycles then BFS-orders from sorted roots, sorting siblings by StringComparer.Ordinal on Id. Exposes Count, indexer -> BoneSnapshot, GetIndex/TryGetIndex, GetChildren(int), HasSameBoneOrder(other) (ordinal id comparison for pose/rest alignment). Rest = Skeleton/SkeletonSnapshot Position+Rotation; posed = PosedSkeleton (positions only).

DEFINITION -> SKELETON: SkeletonInferrer.Infer(CreatureDefinition) (ns ProceduralCreature.Skeleton) primary path ResolvedCreatureSnapshot.Resolve(definition). Every bone position/rotation from CreaturePartWorldTransformResolver (SAME resolver the SDF compiler uses) so skeleton and geometry agree by construction; mesh never touched. Defensive fallback when Resolve throws DomainException (malformed DNA): preserves an independently resolvable Body, resolves remaining parts in try/catch. Body -> AppendBodyBones: one bone per body sample via BodyFrameResolver.ComputeSampleFrames; rotations LookRotation(Tangent,Normal); ids body_j<sampleId>. Non-limb part -> BuildBone: one origin bone (+mirror when flagged). Limb part -> AppendLimbBones: N-1 segment bones + explicit terminal joint node, positions from AUTHORED joints through shared ResolvedLimb derivation (never metaball samples) so render-geometry density changes don't change the rig. Child of limb attaches to terminal joint node (HasChildAttachmentPosition on last segment). Rotations via LimbBoneRotation (look-rotation with deterministic axis substitution for vertical/degenerate).

SemanticBoneResolver (Skeleton/SemanticBoneResolver.cs): single source of part-to-bone mapping (CC-076) - inference, mesh binding, animation queries must agree. Mirror suffix "_mirror", limb segment separator "_j". ResolvePartRootBoneId=part.Id; ResolveLimbSegmentBoneId=part.Id+"_j"+i; ResolveLimbJointBoneId/ResolveLimbTerminalBoneId; ResolveBodySocketBoneId(sampleId)="body"+"_j"+sampleId. ResolveParentBoneId (definition-based and immutable-snapshot-based overloads): Body-rooted parts bind to nearest Body sample bone or via ResolveBodyParentBoneId to anchor segment-start socket (CC-007) when ParentId==BodyId + valid BodySurfaceAnchor; child of limb binds to parent terminal joint bone; child of non-limb binds to parent root bone. Mirrored parent links resolve to mirrored copy only when that parent is also flagged mirrored.

FABRIK (pure math): FabrikSolver.Solve(initialPositions, linkLengths, target, maxIterations, tolerance) (Animation/Ik/FabrikSolver.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Animation.Ik) static, Aristidou & Lasenby 2011, ZERO knowledge of Bone/Skeleton/Transform/GameObject. Unreachable chain -> exact stretch no iteration. Alternating backward/forward passes with early exit. SafeDirection returns Vector3.up when two joints coincide; ValidateInputs enforces >=2 joints, linkLengths.Length==positions-1, positive finite lengths, positive iterations, non-negative tolerance. BoneChain (adapter half): ExtractChain walks ParentBoneId from leaf upward (cycle detection) then reverses root-first; ExtractRestPositions; ComputeLinkLengths. PosedSkeleton (Animation/Ik/PosedSkeleton.cs): immutable POSITION-ONLY runtime current-pose snapshot (no rotations). FromRestPose(Skeleton|SkeletonSnapshot), GetPosition, TryGetPosition, WithUpdatedPositions(updates) returns NEW instance (one posing path, no in-place mutation). Encapsulates a SkeletonSnapshot for bone-order alignment.

IkChainSolver.SolveChainTarget(restSkeleton, currentPose, leafBoneId, targetPosition, maxIterations, tolerance): THE only place FabrikSolver, BoneChain, Skeleton, PosedSkeleton meet. Requires chain >=2 bones (root leaf throws). Link lengths always from REST pose (bones rigid/fixed length); FABRIK seeded from CURRENT pose for faster per-frame convergence + continuity. Returns new PosedSkeleton. Defaults MaxIterations=10, Tolerance=0.01f. SINGLE-CHAIN simplification (one root->leaf chain toward one target; no multi-chain/secondary constraints).

CreatureRig (Animation/CreatureRig.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Animation, sealed MonoBehaviour): "semantic skeleton and pose remain pure data; this component owns only its generated Transform hierarchy and applies poses in world space." Build(Skeleton): captures SkeletonSnapshot, creates one GameObject per bone named "Bone_"+id, parents child->indexed parent (roots to rig transform) SetParent worldPositionStays:false, sets absolute position/rotation from rest. TRANSACTIONAL build: constructs full new hierarchy into next* locals first; on any exception destroys only new objects + rethrows leaving previous rig intact; only on success destroys old + commits. ApplyPose(PosedSkeleton): requires Build first; PoseRotationResolver.ResolveInto reusable rotation buffer then writes transform.position=pose.GetPosition(i), transform.rotation=indexedRotations[i] for every bone. Bones carry no scale. Clear() destroys generated objects + resets (Destroy play / DestroyImmediate edit).

PoseRotationResolver (Animation/Ik/PoseRotationResolver.cs): for a bone with children picks target from bone's own segment endpoint when HasSegment else FindPrimaryChild = LEXICOGRAPHICALLY SMALLEST child id (string.CompareOrdinal) - NO first-child/array-order dependency. Leaf bones retain REST rotation (position-only pose has no separate endpoint). ResolveLookRotation deterministically substitutes Vector3.right as up when forward (anti)parallel to rest up. Requires HasSameBoneOrder(pose.Skeleton) else throws.

DRIVING: NO animation/gait/locomotion/secondary-motion system exists in source. CreatureRig has no Update; applied explicitly on-demand (Build -> ApplyPose). Non-test references only in tests (CreatureRigTests, BoneChainTests). Pipeline: PosedSkeleton positions -> PoseRotationResolver derives rotations from child directions -> CreatureRig.ApplyPose writes absolute world positions + derived rotations. LinearBlendSkinning (Animation/Binding/LinearBlendSkinning.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Animation.Binding): documented pure-math deformation of already-resolved bone frames (BonePose absolute pos+rot), MaxBoneInfluencesPerVertex=4, no SkinnedMeshRenderer, authors no DNA. Editor view: CreatureEditorWindow.DrawSkeletonOverlay (~line 1760) infers rest Skeleton on demand and renders READ-ONLY via SkeletonDisplay (Editor/SkeletonDisplay.cs, BuildBoneLines/BuildJointPoints); never mutates DNA, no Undo, catches DomainException.

MirrorUtility (Skeleton/MirrorUtility.cs), plane X=0, S=Matrix4x4.Scale(-1,1,1): ReflectPointAcrossX(p)=S*p; ReflectTransformAcrossX(M)=S*M (left-multiplied); MirrorAcrossXPlane(M)=S*M*S (CONJUGATION - the correct full rigid-transform mirror; keeps rotation proper since det(S)=-1 so det(S*R*S)=det(R)). Convention: conjugate MirrorAcrossXPlane correct for a single bone at part origin (BuildBone) but NOT for a limb joint offset from origin; AppendLimbBones uses left-multiplied ReflectTransformAcrossX so each mirrored joint lands at S*(world*joint) - matching SDF compiler mirrored limb chain.

INVARIANTS: mirroring does NOT cascade to children (flag every part individually to mirror a chain; flagging only leg leaves foot attached to unmirrored leg - deliberate, no implicit cascading). Skeleton derives from authored joints never metaball samples. Bone Rotation via Matrix4x4.rotation exact under uniform scale, approximation under non-uniform. Single-chain IK. Rigid bones/rest-derived link lengths; positions-only posing; rotations re-derived each apply. Terminal/leaf bones retain rest rotation. Bones carry no scale (bind/posed frames pure rotation+translation so inverse = quaternion inverse). Deterministic ordering (SkeletonSnapshot parent-before-child sorted by ordinal; PoseRotationResolver primary child lexicographic; requires HasSameBoneOrder). One posing path/immutability (WithUpdatedPositions returns new). Degenerate determinism (SafeDirection up, LimbBoneRotation axis substitution, ResolveLookRotation right-up). Guard against fabricating "_j-1" bone id for degenerate single-joint chains (CC-091). Welded Body surface out of scope for LinearBlendSkinning until separately validated.

TESTS: SkeletonInferrerTests(+Limb), SemanticBoneResolverTests, SkeletonSnapshotTests, MirrorUtilityTests, FabrikSolverTests, BoneChainTests, PoseRotationResolverTests, CreatureRigTests (runtime); SkeletonDisplayTests (editor).
Title: CreatureCreator Skeleton, IK, Pose and Rig Layer
